chunks: Who are miserly and bid others to be so, and hide what God has given them in His largesse. We have prepared for unbelievers a shameful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of the disbelievers mentioned in Surah An-Nisa regarding their wealth and faith?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who hoard wealth while outwardly commanding others to do the same, reflecting a spiritual disease of the heart. The 'concealment' of God's bounty refers not only to material wealth but also to withholding knowledge and divine favors from others. This behavior incurs a 'humiliating punishment' (Adhabun Muhin), emphasizing both the internal degradation and external disgrace in the Hereafter.
